summary: The change makes the source generator and analyzer tolerate closed generic value types (including record structs) from referenced assemblies used as members of [MessagePackObject] types. It stops crashing when a metadata member has no declaring syntax (replacing DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] with FirstOrDefault()?) and drops diagnostics whose location is outside the compilation being analyzed via ReportIfLocatedInCompilation. All available checks pass (build, 170-test suite, three new targeted tests), but the fail_without_fix check was not run, so test coverage of the fix cannot be confirmed.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The generator no longer indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences directly for metadata members, and the three new metadata-reference tests pass, each asserting no generator diagnostics and that the expected resolver hint name is generated.
The same FirstOrDefault()? change removes the index-out-of-range throw that surfaced as AD0001, and the new tests run the analyzer through VerifyCS with no diagnostics reported.

reportDiagnostic is now wrapped in ReportIfLocatedInCompilation, which reports only diagnostics whose location is in source and belongs to the compilation being analyzed; the unkeyed-member metadata test passes with no diagnostics reported in the consuming compilation.

evidence.quote: this.reportDiagnostic = reportAnalyzerDiagnostic is null ? null : diagnostic => ReportIfLocatedInCompilation(reportAnalyzerDiagnostic, diagnostic);

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The full source-generator test suite passes with 170 passed and 0 failed, with no failures on base and no new failures, so existing diagnostics for in-compilation types are unchanged.
The fail_without_fix check was not run for this revision (listed in not_run), so there is no evidence that the new tests fail without the fix.

findings.title: New GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper duplicates inline logic
findings.claim: TypeCollector.cs adds a private GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper, but the property diagnostic path still computes the identifier inline instead of calling it, so the helper duplicates existing logic and should either be used or removed.

evidence.quote: var identifier = (syntax as PropertyDeclarationSyntax)?.Identifier ?? (syntax as ParameterSyntax)?.Identifier;

findings.suggested_fix: Replace the inline computation at lines 925-926 with a call to GetPropertyIdentifierLocation, or remove the unused helper.

findings.title: Keyed property from metadata can still crash on DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]
findings.claim: The field diagnostic was fixed to use FirstOrDefault()?, but the keyed-property BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic still indexes DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] directly, which throws the same way for a metadata-origin property and would resurface as CS8785/AD0001. This is pre-existing and outside the issue's tested cases.
findings.suggested_fix: Guard the property syntax access with FirstOrDefault()? and a null location, consistent with the field fix.
